shared_elements: horizontal band of repeating angular (zigzag/triangle) motifs
justification: The only real correspondence is a horizontal register of repeating angular zigzag/triangular marks incised into a pale stone surface, running near the upper part of each object. Otherwise they differ fundamentally: A is a small plain vessel whose sole decoration is that single narrow band, while B is a large slab covered in bold low-relief figural imagery (birds, quadrupeds, arm-like forms) arranged in multiple stacked registers.
